name: r5_prescription_repair_067
command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,sys
p=Path.cwd();s=(p/'src/URMatchingPrescriptions.lean').read_text().replace('  apply Fintype.card_eq_zero
  exact ⟨fun σ => h (σ.property.1.symm.trans σ.property.2)⟩','  let : IsEmpty {σ : PermutationTuples N d // σ c x = y ∧ σ c x = z} :=
    ⟨fun σ => h (σ.property.1.symm.trans σ.property.2)⟩
  exact Fintype.card_eq_zero').replace('  apply Fintype.card_eq_zero
  exact ⟨fun σ => h ((σ.val c).injective (σ.property.1.trans σ.property.2.symm))⟩','  let : IsEmpty {σ : PermutationTuples N d // σ c x = z ∧ σ c y = z} :=
    ⟨fun σ => h ((σ.val c).injective (σ.property.1.trans σ.property.2.symm))⟩
  exact Fintype.card_eq_zero')
subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(p/'write_lane.py'),'src/URMatchingPrescriptions.lean'],input=s,text=True,check=True)
